name: proxmox
description: Proxmox VE view (read-only: node status, VMs, inventory, tasks, task logs, backups, storage, backup coverage) plus one guarded write: create a Home Assistant OS or Ubuntu VM (plan by default, --apply --yes to write).

cli.help: maw proxmox [status|vms|vm <vmid>|inventory|tasks [--failed] [--limit N]|task-log <upid>|backups|ours|storage|create haos|ubuntu --vmid N --name NAME --ip A.B.C.D/24 [--apply --yes]] [--json] [--insecure] [--debug]
